lines.text: The LORD tells Moses to speak to Aaron and his sons about how to bless the Israelites.
The LORD tells Moses to have Joshua and Caleb say the blessing to the Israelites.
The first line of the blessing asks the LORD to bless the people and keep them.
The second line asks the LORD to make His face shine on the people and be stern with them.
The third line asks the LORD to give the people peace, and the priests put His name on them.
